key_insight: ProofTrace identifies structural signatures associated with AI-generated proofs, distinct from changes caused by AI-assisted rewording.
engineering_relevance: Proof-support graphs offer interpretable features for detecting substantive AI involvement that remain stable under AI rewording in the reported experiment.
method: Construct five cohorts spanning human writing and varying levels of AI involvement, including matched research problems.
Represent papers as graphs of immediate proof support and extract mathematical-organization features.
Compare feature patterns and test detection of disclosed substantive AI use.
evidence_signal: Across 8,281 papers, AI-generated proofs showed fewer externally cited results, greater reliance on intermediate conclusions, and altered connectivity; many signatures persisted under field, length, or graph-size controls.
watch_item: Incomplete AI-use disclosure may blur cohort labels, so these signatures should not be treated as definitive evidence for individual papers.
paper_title: The Gold Rush in AI4Math, II: What are signatures of AI-assisted Proofs?
